promotion_note: Promoted 2026-07-28 (owner instruction, pjm-135 session) on the owner's stated criterion -- "if structural integrity improves but gates regress that may still be a keeper" -- which this delta meets a fortiori, since NOTHING regresses and TWO load-bearing criteria IMPROVE. EXACTLY ONE config delta vs the superseded pjm-133 keeper: pjm_external_net_position_cut False -> True. The pjm-133 recipe is otherwise carried VERBATIM -- hydro_budget_nameplate_aware stays on and its budget is preserved to the GWh (15.451/15.819/15.506 TWh, unchanged) -- so this supersedes pjm-133 without dropping its fix. MECHANISM (zero DOF): ONE one-sided aggregate interface row per hour caps the summed injection across all five PJM_external->border links -- i.e. the LP's OWN net interchange -- at the measured (month x hour-of-day) p95 of PJM's published tie-line net position. Same tie-line file, same EXISTING PJM_EXTERNAL_FLOW_PERCENTILE (95.0), same bucketing the per-border envelope already uses, same _build_joint_interface_cut core as the shipped EAST and AP-South cuts. No scale, no haircut, no blend, no new percentile; the DOF ledger goes 14 -> 15 entries with n_residual UNCHANGED at 6. DRIVER: the priced star node was bounded ONLY by MARGINAL per-border, per-direction percentiles (build_pjm_external_flow_groups caps each link at its own border's p95; inject_pjm_seam_flow_limit sizes each neighbor's bands from the same rows, double-counting Dominion via Carolinas+TVA and triple-counting AEP_Ohio via MISO+TVA+LGEE). Five marginal 95th percentiles were summed as though they were a joint one -- 4,235/5,140/5,358 MW against a joint p95 of the simultaneous total of 3,309/3,855/3,996 -- and NOTHING bounded the total. The model's own net interchange therefore ran -28.98/-21.91/-25.92 TWh against a measured -39.98/-32.83/-32.93: the star node supplied PJM with 7.0-11.0 TWh/yr the real seam did not, with a NEGATIVE hourly R^2 and ~10 % of hours more import-heavy than PJM has EVER been in that (month, hour-of-day) bucket. GATES: every criterion PASSES except C3c. C1 FAIL -> PASS (2023 CC_REGULAR -8.45 -> -7.89 TWh against a +/-8.00 band; all 16/16, free 12/12), C3a FAIL -> PASS (2025 -10.7 %), C3c FAIL -> FAIL BYTE-IDENTICAL (7h/18h, 28h/59h) so nothing was bought by damaging the price tail. Fails 3 -> 1; the sole remaining blocker is the C3c scarcity tail, unchanged and long-standing. C6 governance PASSES on the 15-entry DOF ledger. PRE-REGISTERED GATES (PREREG-pjm135-star-node-net-position-cut-2026-07-28.md, committed and pushed BEFORE any arm solved): P1 enforcement 23.25/21.07/18.30 % of hours above the envelope -> 0.00 %, max excess on the constrained flows 0.000000 MW. P2 direction toward the measured value, never past it. K2 ZERO slack and ZERO dump in every arm and every year -- the pre-registered PRINCIPAL RISK, since the cap binds in 93.2/92.1/96.6 % of top-1 % load hours clipping 1,428/1,487/2,334 MW there; PJM's internal fleet covered every megawatt. K5 the pjm-121-lineage control arm reproduces pjm134_control_A BYTE-IDENTICALLY (0.000000000 MW, 19 classes, every hour, all three years). Rule-22 leave-one-year-out clean: same-signed in every year independently (net -1.51/-1.79/-1.72 TWh; CC_REGULAR +0.562/+0.528/+0.49), and the two rubric flips are carried by DIFFERENT years (C1 by 2023, C3a by 2025), so neither rests on one year. SOLVE COST: NONE -- the pjm-121-lineage arm ran 33.6 min against its control's 40; one aggregate row per hour carries none of the ~2.5x per-link penalty pjm-134's AP-South cut paid. HONEST SCOPE, carried and never dropped: (a) this is INERT on the Dominion zonal inversion it was chartered against -- Dominion CT_PEAKER moves +0.024/+0.038/+0.063 TWh against gaps of -6.7/-7.4/-7.2, and only ~15 % of the ISO-wide CC_REGULAR gain lands in Dominion, the rest going west exactly as the measured zero-dual copper-plate predicts (PJM_external is price-tied to EVERY PJM zone in 100.00 % of hours, max |delta| = 0.0000 $/MWh). The C1/C3a gain is an ISO-WIDE level effect, NOT a fix to the zonal allocation defect, which stays OPEN. (b) C1's flip is THIN: -7.89 TWh inside a +/-8.00 band, 1.4 % of margin, and a future delta could flip it back. Rule 1 [R-STRUCT] order of reasoning, for the record: chartered as structurally correct and zero-DOF, with PREREG section 4 pre-registering INERT-on-the-defect as the EXPECTED outcome before any solve; the gate improvement is a consequence, not the justification, and section 4's no-feedback ceiling was honoured -- no percentile, multiplier, haircut or scarcity exemption was applied to the envelope in response, and none may be. Full write-up: results/calibration/FINDING-pjm135-star-node-import-2026-07-28.md. Supersedes 2026-07-27-pjm-133-nameplate.
note: Open ROOT CAUSES. (1) C3c scarcity tail -- now the SOLE failing criterion (model 7h vs RT 18h in 2024, 28h vs 59h in 2025 above $200); unchanged by this delta and by pjm-133/pjm-134 before it. (2) The Dominion CT/CC ZONAL INVERSION stays OPEN, and is now MEASURED rather than merely suspected: pjm-135 M3 shows PJM_external price-tied to every PJM zone in 100.00 % of hours at max |delta| = 0.0000 $/MWh, so the border-flow decomposition is a degenerate vertex artifact and NO per-border re-attribution can bind -- that lever is CLOSED (FINDING-pjm135 section 7 DO-NOT-REDO). (3) The reserve/LP supply-side tightness class (G-20b / ERCOT-G-22: 38.1 GW deliverable 10-min ramp vs a ~3.7 GW requirement, reserve dual never crossing $300) plus the pjm-122 marginal-ownership measurement -- fitted coal rungs own the $40-150 region the measured corpus assigns to the CC top belt and CT_FAST. Carried from pjm-133. (4) DISCLOSED, NOT FIXED, carried from pjm-133: PJM's pinned hydro level is the PS-inclusive EIA-930 NG: WAT, +6.5 to +7.0 TWh/yr above the EIA-923 prime-mover-HY budget -- the nameplate clip pjm-133 removed had been silently deleting that phantom energy, so the fix EXPOSES the pin (rule 14) rather than causing it. Affects every hydro ISO whose BA omits NG: PS. (5) NEW, filed by pjm-135: _PJM_TIE_ZONE assigns the WHOLE TVA tie to Dominion (its largest attributed import, +6.21/+5.40 TWh) while INTERFACE_NEIGHBORS splits TVA across AEP_Ohio and Dominion -- two constructs on the same seam disagree. It conserves the ISO total, so it cannot have caused the net-position defect; an internal-consistency charter, not a defect charter. (6) NEW, filed by pjm-135: PJM CC_CHP runs +42 % (model 8.654 vs a grid-delivered 6.115 TWh in 2023). It passes C1 only because the +/-8 TWh absolute band is generous for a small class, and it is why the Run Explorer's CHP-merged Generation-mix tab read CC Regular at -5.56 TWh while the C1 gate scored the unmerged CC_REGULAR at -8.10 -- the display has since been un-merged and given the volume leg.
